title: deeplethe/forkd
claim: forkd — fork() for AI-agent microVMs: keep one warm KVM parent, then spawn 100 copy-on-write children in ~100ms or branch a live VM in ~56ms. Rust, Apache-2.0, Python SDK, portable snapshot hub.
why_good: Agent workloads are turning into tree search — try N approaches in parallel, keep the winner — and that needs isolation at fork() speed, which containers and cold-boot VMs don't give. The CoW snapshot model plus a 'forkd pull' snapshot hub echoes how Docker Hub anchored Docker.
value: 商业价值: usage-priced sandbox infra for agent platforms (per-fork / per-VM-hour) plus a hosted snapshot registry — the same budget teams already pay E2B and Modal for agent sandboxes.
risk: Firecracker snapshot-restore is well-trodden ground E2B/Modal/Daytona could replicate quickly, and KVM-only means no native Mac/Windows story. 5 contributors and 18 commits/30d suggest momentum is already cooling.
